snippet.title: The Hero's Legacy - Official Early Access Trailer | Hardcore Co-op Pixel ARPG
snippet.description:
The Hero's Legacy is a pixel ARPG that mixes the bullet-hell co-op of Realm of the Mad God with the loot and builds of Path of Exile and Diablo.

Early Access on Steam: November 9, 2026. Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5416430/The_Heros_Legacy/

Dodge bullet-hell bosses, chase ground loot and 6-link gear, and build your hero on a huge passive tree.

-12 classes, a huge passive tree and game-changing keystones
-6-link sockets, skill runes + sigils, uniques, gear sets
-Crafting orbs, including the Twinning Glass jackpot
-Bullet-hell bosses, dragons and world bosses
-Ember Rifts endgame with Steam leaderboards, plus a pinnacle fight
-Solo offline, online, LAN, or 4-player couch co-op (split screen)
-Woodcutting, mining, fishing, cooking, crafting, herblore and farming

For fans of deep ARPG builds, loot hunting and bullet-hell co-op chaos.

Website: https://theheroslegacy.com
Studio: https://craftingbenchgames.com

#TheHerosLegacy #ARPG #PixelArt #IndieGame
